moves.name: MLA decode by absorbing K/V projection weights into latent-cache attention
moves.description: Decode projects q_nope with w_kc, attends over the kv_lora_rank+RoPE latent cache as a single-KV-head MQA problem, then de-absorbs the value result with w_vc. This avoids materializing per-head K/V and lets generic MQA/GQA decode kernels run over compressed latent states.
moves.problem_solved: Per-head K/V expansion and cache bandwidth in MLA decode.
semantic_preconditions: Model exposes MLA dimensions kv_lora_rank and qk_rope_head_dim.
Weight absorption is used for decode/extend paths, not all prefill cases.
hardware_preconditions: CUDA/HIP device capable of batched GEMM and selected attention backend.
framework_preconditions: RadixAttention receives num_kv_heads=1 and v_head_dim=kv_lora_rank for latent-cache decode.

assumptions.assumption: Compressed latent cache is shaped as one KV head of kv_lora_rank+RoPE dimensions.
Offline transposition preserves the absorbed-value GEMM semantics.

moves.performance_evidence: PR #1261 transposes absorbed weights offline; no numeric result in checked diff.

moves.name: MHA-style MLA prefill without weight absorption
moves.description: Long prefill/extend without cached prefix uses the normal kv_b_proj path, materializing k_nope and v before attention. Decode and prefix-bearing extend remain on the absorbed path, separating throughput-prefill from memory-bound decode.
moves.problem_solved: Absorbed MLA was not optimal or convenient for full prefill where dense MHA-style computation is available.

first_observed.evidence: Use normal computation for prefill and use weight absorption for extend/decode

semantic_preconditions: forward_batch.forward_mode.is_extend() and extend_prefix_lens.sum()==0 selects normal computation in the introducing diff.
hardware_preconditions: Backend supports materialized per-head K/V prefill.

assumptions.assumption: No-prefix extend is treated as prefill for this branch.

moves.correctness_evidence: Covered by MLA tests in registry; no specific assertion found.

moves.name: Split-KV flash-decoding with LSE merge and dynamic per-batch split counts
moves.description: The Triton decode kernel splits a sequence's KV range across CTAs, stores per-split partial values and log-sum-exp, then a second stage merges them with online-softmax correction. Later dynamic-workload changes load num_kv_splits per batch and launch to max_kv_splits so short and long requests can share a batch more efficiently.
moves.problem_solved: Long-context decode underutilization and load imbalance across heterogeneous batch sequence lengths.
semantic_preconditions: KV indices/indptr define each request's cached token span.
Merge stage receives per-split LSE values.
hardware_preconditions: Triton target supports the selected BLOCK_N/BLOCK_H launch geometry.
framework_preconditions: max_kv_splits workspace is allocated and num_kv_splits is valid per batch item.

assumptions.assumption: Splits cover the sequence by ceil-dividing each request length and skipping empty splits.

moves.performance_evidence: #4553 is a dynamic-workload optimization; no numeric result in checked diff.
moves.correctness_evidence: #2479 later fixed a correctness issue for the Triton decoding kernel.

known_failures.what: Fix correctness issue for triton decoding kernel

moves.name: FlashInfer MLA plan/run split with CUDA-graph-safe fast planning
moves.description: SGLang wraps FlashInfer BatchMLAPagedAttentionWrapper with explicit plan calls before run, keeping workspace and plan buffers across layers/batches. The fast plan path passes CPU indptrs and pinned workspace to FlashInfer's cached module during graph replay to avoid stream synchronization.
moves.problem_solved: Repeated host planning overhead and CUDA graph replay blocking for FlashInfer MLA decode.
semantic_preconditions: Batch metadata is known before run.
KV page tables and q/kv indptrs match FlashInfer MLA API.
hardware_preconditions: FlashInfer supports the selected backend and GPU architecture.
framework_preconditions: CUDA graph replay reuses preallocated qo_indptr/kv_indptr/kv_lens buffers.

assumptions.assumption: Fast plan avoids synchronization during graph replay by using CPU indptrs.
assumptions.excerpt: for skipping the stream synchronization in original plan function during cuda graph replaying

moves.performance_evidence: confirmed-reverts.csv row 26 says #3987 fast decode plan regressed other cases; #4012 revised it.

known_failures.what: fast decode plan reverted for performance regression
CUDA graph replay issues for FlashInfer MLA

moves.name: FlashInfer ragged MLA prefill for no-prefix extends
moves.description: The FlashInfer MLA backend chooses BatchPrefillWithRaggedKVCacheWrapper when ragged prefill is enabled and extend has no cached prefix; otherwise it plans the paged MLA wrapper. This separates contiguous prefill work from paged prefix-cache work.
moves.problem_solved: Paged prefill overhead when there is no prefix cache to reuse.

occurrences.evidence: Fix chunked prefix cache for nvfp4
public trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla entry point builds a fresh plan

semantic_preconditions: extend_no_prefix is true for ragged path.
Prefix lengths are available for qo_indptr computation.
hardware_preconditions: FlashInfer ragged prefill wrapper is installed and supports dtype/head dimensions.

assumptions.assumption: Ragged prefill is selected only when every extend has no prefix.

moves.correctness_evidence: FlashInfer MLA unit tests in registry; chunked-prefix repair #10180.

known_failures.what: Fix chunked prefix cache for nvfp4

moves.name: FlashMLA tile-scheduler metadata and graph-replayed num_splits
moves.description: FlashMLA decode precomputes tile_scheduler_metadata and num_splits with get_mla_metadata, then passes both to flash_mla_with_kvcache. CUDA graph support copies recomputed metadata into fixed graph buffers before replay.
moves.problem_solved: Persistent/tile-scheduled decode needs scheduler metadata while CUDA graphs need stable buffer addresses.
semantic_preconditions: Sequence lengths are known for metadata construction.
num_splits matches tile_scheduler_metadata.
framework_preconditions: FlashMLA page_size is 64 in SGLang integration.

assumptions.assumption: FlashMLA only supports page_size 64 in this backend.

moves.name: Paged latent MLA KV cache with fused writes and FP8 scale side buffers
moves.description: MLATokenToKVPool stores one buffer per layer with kv_lora_rank latent values followed by RoPE dimensions; writers use set_mla_kv_buffer kernels to place no-PE and RoPE parts in one paged layout. Later FP8 paths add quantized write kernels and scale buffers.
moves.problem_solved: MLA needs compact cache storage and fast per-token writes without expanding K/V heads.

occurrences.evidence: fused cat+FP8-quantize for MLA chunked-prefill K/V

semantic_preconditions: Cache tensor's last dimension is kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim.
Write locations are page-aligned or resolved for paged layouts.
hardware_preconditions: Triton/CUDA path available for fused writes; FP8 dtype support for quantized cache.
framework_preconditions: FlashMLA uses page_size 64; other MLA pools typically page_size 1 unless backend overrides.

assumptions.assumption: MLA has a single kv_buffer, so transfer metadata is one buffer per layer.
HND paged layouts require (size+page_size) divisible by page_size.

moves.performance_evidence: #25333 fuses cat+FP8 quantize; no numeric result in checked evidence.

known_failures.what: page-size greater than 1 for FlashInfer MLA reverted

moves.name: FlashAttention-3 MLA backend selected by default on Hopper
moves.description: The FA3 backend maps absorbed MLA decode to flash_attn_with_kvcache over q_rope and the RoPE cache, and SGLang selects fa3 by default on Hopper/CUDA>=12.3 unless incompatible features intervene. This is an architecture-specialized backend choice rather than a new model equation.
moves.problem_solved: Hopper MLA decode/prefill performance using FA3 kernels instead of the generic Triton fallback.
semantic_preconditions: Attention architecture is MLA and MLA is not disabled.
Speculative path and FP8 dtype restrictions do not force fallback.
hardware_preconditions: Hopper SM90 and CUDA >= 12.3 for SGLang default selection.

assumptions.assumption: FA3 default is limited to Hopper CUDA 12.3 path in the introducing default-selection change.

moves.performance_evidence: Default switch PR #5210 implies preferred performance; no numeric result in checked diff.

moves.name: ROCm fused MLA decode with RoPE preprocessing
moves.description: The ROCm Triton kernel fuses rotary application for q_pe/k_pe with grouped MLA decode stage 1, including optional output of rotated k_pe tokens. This removes separate RoPE preprocessing around decode on AMD paths.
moves.problem_solved: Extra RoPE launches and memory traffic before MLA decode on ROCm.
semantic_preconditions: RoPE dimensions are the suffix after kv_lora_rank.
Last-token k_pe handling is valid for decode.
framework_preconditions: Caller supplies cos_sin_cache, positions, rotary_dim and use_rope flag.

assumptions.assumption: RoPE fusion requires output k_pe tokens when enabled.
assumptions.excerpt: We must output the k_pe tokens with rope applied if rope fusion enabled.

moves.name: TRT-LLM Gen MLA decode via FlashInfer
moves.description: The backend subclasses FlashInfer MLA, constructs padded block tables satisfying FlashInfer/TRT-LLM block constraints, then calls flashinfer.decode.trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla for decode. It became the Blackwell/explicit replacement direction after CUTLASS MLA removal.
moves.problem_solved: Low-latency specialized MLA decode on NVIDIA backends without maintaining an in-tree CUTLASS kernel.
